public_derivative_note: Public historical document derivative, prepared 2026-10-23. Original bytes are preserved privately. Decisions and timing remain those of this revision; unchanged passages reproduce the historical source. Exact edits and both identities are recorded in reports/public_document_derivatives.json.
scope: Fresh reconstruction of all27 public assets and applicable fixed V2 claims; new finite validation below. Prior results comparison-only except explicitly verified completed V1 bootstrap and fixed geometric/fold definitions. No sealed Test, new model family selection, paid compute or publication.
questions: Can all current public quantities be reproduced from available verified inputs?
Does training-only interpolation performance support its historical ranking under matched spatial and coordinate-group validation?
Are kNN inference and conclusions stable to row order, zero distances and identity-aligned randomization?
What is conditional rolling-origin performance by horizon with training-only parameter fitting?
What do finite effect sizes and uncertainty support about vulnerability and cross-sample comparisons?

interpolation.training_preprocessing: Every response-dependent transform and variogram fitted exclusively to training rows. No global response-tuned parameter. Same folds/training rows for both methods.
interpolation.inference: descriptive performance with10/5dependent spatial folds; no i.i.d. significance claim or winner-based retuning
interpolation.surface: Fresh IDW at existing2degree resolution retained for continuity, independent of new scores; evaluation ranking reported separately. No optional exactLOO added.

neighbor_order.identities: full Country/City/signedLatitude/Longitude source key; self excluded by identity
neighbor_order.tie_policy: All candidates with chord distance <= kth distance +1e-12 considered at boundary; all strictly closer than kth-1e-12 retained, remaining boundary choices sorted by persistent identity. No zero-distance record dropped; k8, self excluded by identity. Canonicalize summation order for comparisons.
neighbor_order.statistics: all3city specifications and two country stability residuals; k8;199permutations seed0; alpha0.05
neighbor_order.randomization: same199identity-indexed residual permutations for graph-only comparison; separately replay existing positional permutations to isolate randomization-sequence effects
metrics: max graph/statistic/inference differences under deterministic variant
neighbor_order.acceptance: deterministic graph identical after identity alignment, I absolute tolerance1e-12, p exact; report any historical sensitivity without selecting favorable order

forecast.training: Explicit year<=origin mask replaces hardcoded2013; standardization, rho and evidence-selected lambda refit using training rows only; fixed predeclared lags unchanged; final training residual/design at origin
forecast.baseline: 1951-1980 known before all origins; cached source vintages are retrospective
forecast.convergence: Record original iteration path/RHO_TOL/MAX_ITERS; no automatic retuning or increased iteration acceptance; flag nonconvergence
forecast.drivers: observed future drivers: conditional retrospective hindcast, not real-time forecast
forecast.uncertainty: 24overlapping predictions per horizon; descriptive coverage only, no independent-binomial calibration assertion. Keep fixed-parameter formula separate. Assess limitations; one concrete refit-parametric-bootstrap extension may be proposed but not executed.

interpretation.vulnerability: Preserve original descriptive criteria; additionally show finite-pair Spearman effect sizes with2000country/bootstrap and whole-continent block percentile intervals, seeds0/1, on original pair-specific and common-complete samples. No equivalence test or invented margin. Country/block uncertainty limitations explicit.
interpretation.comparison: Report sample counts/identities for all national warming/CO2definitions; distinguish composite ND-GAIN from capacity alone; hardcoded prose checked against fresh numeric results.

numerical_tolerances.bootstrap_saved_precision: exact where reused; raw-design equivalence separately recorded
